headlines.title: Trump Hits 4 States in 5 Days in Final Push to November Midterms
headlines.description: With four weeks to go until the crucial midterm elections, President Donald Trump is making an all-out push to rally Republicans, trying to appeal to voters on the economy. The president also made rare reversals on mail-in voting and who will pay for the controversial political ads about himself. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Local officials weigh in on political polarization
headlines.description: NBC News' Megan Brand spoke to local officials about their views about the rise in political polarization in their communities.

headlines.title: NBC’s Steve Kornacki Breaks Down Where Midterm Numbers Stand
headlines.description: With midterm elections just a month away, NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki joins TODAY to discuss the latest poll numbers, where the Senate and the House stand, what battleground states to keep an eye on, the major issues on the minds of voters, and more.

headlines.title: Trump Rallies for Republicans Ahead of Midterm Elections
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is making a major push in once-reliable Republican states as a new NBC News poll shows his party could be facing an uphill battle ahead of the midterm elections. It comes as new Trump ads, paid for by taxpayers, get prime-time air, some during football games. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Cornell Faculty Plan Vote of No Confidence Against Administrators
headlines.description: As protests intensify at Cornell over the university’s handling of an alleged 2024 sexual assault, members of the faculty are now reportedly planning a vote of no confidence against school administrators. It comes as university disciplinary records show the fraternity members allegedly tried to coordinate their responses after Jane Doe went to campus police. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Paramount Skydance completes $110 billion ​takeover of Warner Bros.
headlines.description: Paramount Skydance completed its $110 billion ​takeover of Warner Bros., creating a Hollywood heavyweight called Skydance and handing CEO David ‌Ellison control. NBC News' Brian Cheung reports on the details of the merger.

headlines.title: Russia says no plague found in contacts of Siberian lab worker who died
headlines.description: Plague had not been detected among close contacts of a worker in an anti-plague laboratory in Siberia who died last week, with 60% of the identified group tested so far, officials in Russia said Tuesday.

headlines.title: California officials condemn Trump for saying Iran could ‘take out’ Los Angeles or San Diego
headlines.description: California officials denounced President Donald Trump for saying at a campaign rally in Nebraska on Monday that Iran could “take out” Los Angeles or San Diego, calling his remarks “deranged” and “irresponsible.”

headlines.title: Inside NATO operation to protect European countries from Russia
headlines.description: A NATO mission in Europe is defending against hundreds of Russian drones and aircraft that have been entering alliance airspace. NBC News was on the ground to get a first-hand look at where NATO fighter jets and air defence systems have been deployed to protect the eastern flank. NBC News’ Richard Engel reports.

headlines.title: Flydubai pilot planned 9/11-style attack, source tells NBC News
headlines.description: The pilot who tried to bring down an Israel-bound flight had been planning a 9/11-style attack, a Middle Eastern official has told NBC News.

headlines.title: Jim Bakker, Controversial Televangelist, Dies at 86
headlines.description: Jim Bakker, the charismatic preacher who built a Christian television empire with his wife Tammy Faye before it collapsed in scandal, has died at the age of 86. NBC’s Stephanie Gosk reports for TODAY with a look back on the many highs and lows of his life.

headlines.title: Live updates: The absolute best October Prime Day deals, hand-picked by a shopping reporter
headlines.description: NBC Selected editors are tracking the best October Prime Day deals live, with prices and recommendations updated throughout the event. Here’s what’s worth buying.
